nombre: ley de ohm con la pasita invocadora

hobby.detalle: la Pasita, invocadora de un mundo anime que canaliza su poder hasta la mano para abrir su círculo de invocación

arte.universo: An original anime fantasy world, painted in polished soft-3D anime style: a mountain temple training ground at twilight with stone steps, wooden torii-like gates without any writing, paper lanterns, cherry trees with petals in the wind, mist and floating fireflies. The Pasita is a young summoner: white and lime-green training robe with a sash, a lime headband with a small PASAS raisin-in-a-circle emblem, bare glowing palms. When she uses her power, glowing lime-green channels of light run from a bright core in her chest along her arm to her palm. Her summons come out of geometric hexagonal summoning circles (hexagon and six-pointed star shapes with the PASAS raisin emblem in the center, NEVER spirals, never swirls, never clan or village symbols). Blocking seals are plain rectangular yellow paper talismans with a simple dark X mark (no letters, no characters, no writing). The energy that reaches her palm appears as round cyan glowing orbs, always counted exactly. The rival is a simple round generic character in a plain dark hooded robe and a blank white mask (not the Pasita, not any existing character). Palette: deep twilight purple and indigo, lime-green accent glow, cyan orbs, warm lantern orange. No text, digits, letters, logos or brand marks anywhere.

post:
¿La Ley de Ohm no te entra? Piénsala como en un anime: la Pasita empuja su poder hasta la mano, y cada sello que le pegan deja pasar menos aura. ✨

Así se explica en PASAS: cada tema con lo que te gusta (videojuegos, anime, K-pop o fútbol).

La última lámina es tu acordeón: guárdala para tu examen de física.

pasos.t: Anota los datos con unidades: **V** en volts, **I** en amperes, **R** en ohms (Ω).

pasos.f: I = V ÷ R → 24 V ÷ 8 Ω = 3 A
V = I × R · R = V ÷ I

slides.recuerdo: Más sellos, menos esferas: **más resistencia, menos corriente**, aunque el voltaje no cambie.
slides.atajo: Triángulo de Ohm: **V** arriba, **I** y **R** abajo. Tapa lo que buscas.
